name: Imparsthetic
summary: The aesthetic tackles themes of nature, consumerism, nostalgia, and change, with a particular interest in evaluating the way the internet has evolved over the past 30 years.
description: The aesthetic tackles themes of nature, consumerism, nostalgia, and change, with a particular interest in evaluating the way the internet has evolved over the past 30 years. The word "Imparsthetic" is a combination of the Latin adjective "impar," meaning "unequal," "uneven," "odd," or "inferior," and the word "aesthetic."
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Consumerism, confusion, curiosity, nostalgia, surrealism
